data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew words ‘zoph’ (hide, conceal) and ‘niel’ (God). In the Bible, Zophaniel is not mentioned, but the name is found in Jewish literature. The name Zophaniel carries the meaning “God's hiding place” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Zophaniel usually hope their child will grow to embody god's hiding place and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's protective presence.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zophaniel total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
